Anchoring.description:
How the Evidence records of an Operator are anchored in time.

Attributes:
    QUALIFIED_TIMESTAMPING: A qualified timestamping authority seals the records.
    PUBLIC_BLOCKCHAIN: A public blockchain seals the records.
    NONE: The records are not anchored.

CellAssignment.description:
The cell an operator belongs to, and since when.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys.
    operator_id (UUID): The version 7 identifier of the operator.
    cell (str): The name of the cell.
    assigned_at (datetime): The moment of the assignment, in UTC.

Notes:
    - An operator lives in exactly one cell.
    - No field has a default, so ``None`` is refused.

Operator.description:
The organisation that flies Missions for its Clients, global to every cell.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The validator mode that runs before Pydantic's own validation.
    ID_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``id`` field.
    NAME_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``name`` field.
    DEPLOYMENT_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``deployment`` field.
    JURISDICTIONS_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``jurisdictions`` field.
    LLM_PROVIDER_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``llm_provider`` field.
    ANCHORING_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``anchoring`` field.
    id (UUID): The version 7 identifier of the Operator.
    name (str): The name of the Operator.
    deployment (Deployment): Where the Operator's Swarm runs.
    jurisdictions (List[Jurisdiction]): The jurisdictions the Operator flies under, at least one, no duplicate.
    llm_provider (LlmProvider): The kind of language model of its AI agents, Claude by default.
    anchoring (Anchoring): How its Evidence records are anchored, qualified timestamping by default.

Notes:
    - An Operator lives in exactly one cell, given by its ``CellAssignment``.
    - ``id``, ``name``, ``deployment`` and ``jurisdictions`` have no default, so ``None`` is refused for them.
    - ``None`` becomes the default for ``llm_provider`` and ``anchoring``.

OperatorEntry.description:
The body of the request that creates an Operator.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The validator mode that runs before Pydantic's own validation.
    NAME_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``name`` field.
    DEPLOYMENT_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``deployment`` field.
    JURISDICTIONS_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``jurisdictions`` field.
    LLM_PROVIDER_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``llm_provider`` field.
    ANCHORING_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``anchoring`` field.
    PLANNER_NAME_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``first_mission_planner_name`` field.
    PLANNER_EMAIL_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``first_mission_planner_email`` field.
    EMAIL_SEPARATOR (ClassVar[str]): The character between the local part and the domain of an address.
    DOMAIN_SEPARATOR (ClassVar[str]): The character that must appear in the domain of an address.
    name (Optional[str]): The name of the Operator, if given.
    deployment (Optional[Deployment]): Where its Swarm runs, if given.
    jurisdictions (List[Jurisdiction]): The jurisdictions it flies under, without duplicate.
    llm_provider (Optional[LlmProvider]): The kind of language model of its AI agents, if given.
    anchoring (Anchoring): How its Evidence records are anchored.
    first_mission_planner_name (Optional[str]): The name of its first Mission planner, if given.
    first_mission_planner_email (Optional[str]): The email address of its first Mission planner, if given.

Notes:
    - It is lenient on presence, so that the service can name every field that is missing.
    - A blank text becomes ``None``, and ``None`` becomes the default.

Problem.description:
A problem document, as RFC 9457 defines it, answered as ``application/problem+json``.

Attributes:
    model_config (ConfigDict): Forbids unknown keys and freezes the document.
    MEDIA_TYPE (ClassVar[str]): The media type of the document.
    TYPE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``type`` field.
    TITLE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``title`` field.
    STATUS_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``status`` field.
    DETAIL_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``detail`` field.
    INSTANCE_FIELD (ClassVar[str]): The name of the ``instance`` field.
    DEFAULT_TYPE (ClassVar[str]): The ``type`` of a problem with no more meaning than its status.
    STATUS_MIN (ClassVar[int]): The lowest status of an error.
    STATUS_MAX (ClassVar[int]): The highest status of an error.
    BEFORE (ClassVar[Literal["before"]]): The mode of the validators.
    type (str): A URI reference that identifies the kind of problem.
    title (str): A short, human-readable summary of the kind of problem.
    status (int): The HTTP status of the answer.
    detail (Optional[str]): A human-readable explanation of this occurrence.
    instance (Optional[str]): A URI reference that identifies this occurrence.

Notes:
    - ``None`` for ``detail`` and ``instance`` means the member is left out of the document.
    - A built problem never changes, so it can be shared between handlers.
